description: RAD51D conservation with corrected orthologue accessions, and positional test of missense VUS
code:
import requests, re, json, time, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0 (research)"}
EUT="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"

def post_sum(ids):
    for a in range(6):
        try:
            j=requests.post(EUT+"esummary.fcgi",data={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids),"retmode":"json"},
                            headers=H,timeout=60).json()
            if "result" in j: return j["result"]
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(2.0+a)
    return {}
def clinvar(term):
    ids=requests.get(EUT+"esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":term,"retmode":"json","retmax":1500},
                     headers=H,timeout=60).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
    out=[]
    for i in range(0,len(ids),120):
        res=post_sum(ids[i:i+120]); time.sleep(0.6)
        for k in res.get("uids",[]): out.append(res[k].get("variation_set",[{}])[0].get("variation_name",""))
    return out
AA3={'Ala','Arg','Asn','Asp','Cys','Gln','Glu','Gly','His','Ile','Leu','Lys','Met','Phe','Pro','Ser','Thr','Trp','Tyr','Val'}
def mis(names):
    out=[]
    for n in names:
        m=re.search(r"\(p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)([A-Z][a-z]{2})\)",n)
        if m and m.group(1) in AA3 and m.group(3) in AA3 and m.group(1)!=m.group(3): out.append(int(m.group(2)))
    return sorted(set(out))
vus=mis(clinvar('RAD51D[gene] AND "clinsig vus"[Properties]'))
ben=mis(clinvar('RAD51D[gene] AND ("clinsig benign"[Properties] OR "clinsig likely benign"[Properties])'))

accs={"human (O75771)":"O75771","mouse (O55230)":"O55230","rat (A6HHF0)":"A6HHF0",
      "cow (Q2HJ51)":"Q2HJ51","zebrafish (F1R474)":"F1R474","X. tropicalis (Q6DJR4)":"Q6DJR4",
      "D. melanogaster (A1Z7R8)":"A1Z7R8","C. elegans rfs-1 (P34348)":"P34348"}
seqs={}
for k,a in accs.items():
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",headers=H,timeout=40)
    if r.ok and r.text.startswith(">"): seqs[k]="".join(r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
hs=seqs["human (O75771)"]; L=len(hs)

def nw(a,b,g=-2.0):
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    S=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    S[0,1:]=g*np.arange(1,m+1); P[0,1:]=2; S[1:,0]=g*np.arange(1,n+1); P[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]; rp=S[i-1]; ro=S[i]; po=P[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=rp[j-1]+(2.0 if ai==b[j-1] else -1.0); u=rp[j]+g; l=ro[j-1]+g
            if d>=u and d>=l: ro[j]=d; po[j]=0
            elif u>=l: ro[j]=u; po[j]=1
            else: ro[j]=l; po[j]=2
    i,j=n,m; mt=np.zeros(n,dtype=bool)
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0:
            if a[i-1]==b[j-1]: mt[i-1]=True
            i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return mt

cons=np.zeros(L); nsp=0
print("=== Global identity to human RAD51D ===")
for k,s in seqs.items():
    if k.startswith("human"): continue
    m=nw(hs,s); cons+=m.astype(float); nsp+=1
    print(f"  {k:28s} len={len(s):4d}  identity={m.mean():.3f}")
cons/=nsp

core=84; f=(L-core+1)/L
v=np.array(vus); b=np.array(ben)
nc=int((v>=core).sum()); bt=stats.binomtest(nc,len(v),f,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nMissense VUS residues n={len(v)}; in ATPase core (84-328) {nc} = {100*nc/len(v):.1f}% vs {100*f:.1f}% expected")
print(f"  one-sided binomial p={bt.pvalue:.3f}, obs/exp={(nc/len(v))/f:.3f}, 95% CI of proportion {bt.proportion_ci()}")
ks=stats.kstest((v-1)/L,'uniform')
print(f"  KS test of VUS positions vs uniform: D={ks.statistic:.4f}, p={ks.pvalue:.3f}")
nb=int((b>=core).sum()); orr,pf=stats.fisher_exact([[nc,len(v)-nc],[nb,len(b)-nb]])
print(f"B/LB residues n={len(b)}; in core {nb}; VUS vs B/LB OR={orr:.2f}, Fisher p={pf:.3f}")
cv=cons[v-1]; cb=cons[b-1]
U,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu(cv,cb,alternative="greater"); U2,pu2=stats.mannwhitneyu(cv,cons,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nConservation at VUS: mean {cv.mean():.3f} vs all residues {cons.mean():.3f} (U={U2:.0f}, p={pu2:.3f})")
print(f"  VUS vs B/LB: {cv.mean():.3f} vs {cb.mean():.3f} (U={U:.0f}, p={pu:.3f})")
print(f"Walker A 107-114 mean {cons[106:114].mean():.3f}; K113={cons[112]:.3f}; S207={cons[206]:.3f}")
print(f"N-term 1-83 {cons[:83].mean():.3f} vs core {cons[83:].mean():.3f}")
print("VUS per 100 aa: N-term %.1f, core %.1f"%(100*(len(v)-nc)/83,100*nc/(L-83)))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,6.8),sharex=True,gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2,1.25]})
ax=axes[0]; w=9; sm=np.convolve(cons,np.ones(w)/w,mode="same")
ax.fill_between(np.arange(1,L+1),0,sm,color="#4c72b0",alpha=.35,lw=0)
ax.plot(np.arange(1,L+1),sm,color="#2a4d78",lw=1.4)
ax.axvspan(1,83,color="#bbbbbb",alpha=.45); ax.axvspan(107,114,color="#d62728",alpha=.35)
ax.text(42,1.05,"N-terminal ssDNA-binding region 1-83",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.text(206,1.05,"RecA-like ATPase core 84-328",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.annotate("Walker A GGPGSGKT (K113)",xy=(111,sm[110]),xytext=(142,0.20),fontsize=8.5,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=1))
ax.set_ylabel("identity to human\n(7 orthologues, 9-aa mean)"); ax.set_ylim(0,1.15)
ax.set_title("A. RAD51D conservation from mouse to C. elegans rfs-1",fontsize=11)
ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(v,bins=np.arange(0,L+9,8),color="#dd8452",label=f"missense VUS ({len(v)} residues)")
ax.scatter(b,np.full(len(b),-1.8),marker="v",color="#55a868",s=40,zorder=5,label=f"benign / likely benign ({len(b)})")
ax.scatter([207],[-1.8],marker="*",color="#c44e52",s=170,zorder=6,label="S207L, the one P/LP missense")
ax.axvspan(1,83,color="#bbbbbb",alpha=.45); ax.axvspan(107,114,color="#d62728",alpha=.35)
ax.set_xlabel("RAD51D residue (UniProt O75771, 328 aa)"); ax.set_ylabel("variants per 8 aa")
ax.set_xlim(0,L+2); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper left",frameon=False)
ax.set_title(f"B. VUS tile the protein evenly: {100*nc/len(v):.1f}% in the ATPase core against {100*f:.1f}% expected from length (p = {bt.pvalue:.2f})",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
